title: Lydecker LLP Rolls Out Automated Time Entry | PointOne
summary: Lydecker LLP, a Florida-based law firm with offices across multiple markets, is deploying PointOne across the firm, bringing automated time entry to its 98 timekeepers and eliminating the manual reconstruction of the workday.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, September 8, 2026** — PointOne, the AI revenue platform for law firms, today announced the firmwide deployment of PointOne Time at Lydecker LLP. The rollout brings automated time capture to attorneys and paralegals across the firm.


PointOne Time captures work as it happens across attorneys’ phones, iPads, and laptops, then automatically drafts corresponding time entries—eliminating the need to reconstruct the day from memory. Attorneys retain control over their entries, while assistants and billing teams can review, refine, and release time through a shared workflow.


At Lydecker, PointOne integrates with the firm’s existing Clio environment, replacing a largely manual time-entry process with a more seamless and consistent experience.


### About Lydecker


Lydecker is a nationally recognized, AV-rated law firm representing insurers, businesses, governmental entities, and self-insured organizations. With offices across the United States, the firm provides strategic counsel across commercial litigation, insurance defense, professional liability, construction, employment, government, and business matters.


### About PointOne


PointOne is the AI revenue platform purpose-built for law firms. Its technology helps legal teams reduce manual administrative work while maintaining enterprise-grade security, privacy, and control. Beyond timekeeping, PointOne helps firms streamline billing workflows and unlock operational intelligence across the revenue lifecycle.
